steps.description:
"The program plays continuously until the stop Button in the blockly is pressed
The movement must be interchangeablewithout stopping the program

Show that your robot can perform the following one Button:
1. When no Button is pressed, the car will not move
2. When Button A is pressed and held, the car will immediately go forward at the speed of 100

Hint:
1. Forever Loop
2. Set Motor type to on"

The program plays continuously until the stop Button in the blockly is pressed
The movement must be interchangeablewithout stopping the program

Show that your robot can perform the following one Button:
1. When no Button is pressed, the car will go forward at the speed of 100
2. When Button A is pressed and held, the car will immediately go backwards at the speed of 100
3. Upon Button A is released, the car perform step 1 instruction

Hint:
1. Forever Loop
2. Set Motor type to on

Show that your robot can perform the following two Button:
1. When no Button is pressed, the car will go forward
2. When Button A is pressed and held, the car will immediately turn left.
3. When Button B is pressed and held, the car will immediately turn right
4. Upon releasing of Button A and B, the car will perform step 1 instruction

Hint:
1. Forever Loop
2. Set Motor type to on

The program plays continuously until the stop Button in the blockly is pressed
The movement must be interchangeablewithout stopping the program

Show that your robot can perform the following two Button:
1. When no Button is pressed, the car will go forward
2. When Button A is pressed and held, the car will immediately turn left.
3. When Button B is pressed and held, the car will immediately turn right
5. When both Button A and B are pressed and hold, the car will immediately move backwards
6. Upon releasing of Button A and B, the car will perform step 1 instruction

Hint:
1. Forever Loop
2. Set Motor type to on
